system.description:
Acquired with CR11 or higher. Deal [SR x [STR mod]] direct damage to the target. This damage triggers [Weakness] on the secondary target, as if they had failed their [Dodge Check]. You may only use this skill when you have the [Fairy] tag.

A special skill that commands the summoned spirits to attack the enemy with magic arrows. The attack of the spirit, which has increased its ability through synchronization, exhibits a power that is distinct from that of a mediocre one.
